Hi, the basic first-time setup is:

Choose a water source. Use a raised reservoir for gravity watering, or a faucet or hose only with the proper blumat pressure reducer. Never connect raw tap pressure directly.
Install the sensor in the growing medium with firm soil contact. In a pot, place the ceramic tip about halfway between the center and the wall, ideally about halfway down the soil profile and not deeper than about 6 inches.
Connect the tubing from the water source to the sensor, then to the drippers if your kit includes them.
Place any drippers around the root zone so water is distributed evenly.
Test the setup and make small adjustments after the soil has had time to respond.
